column1: # Kitob qamrovi: qaysi kitob bobi korpusga kirgan.
# Bir qator - bitta kitob bobi (Effective Java da bitta Item), ya'ni
# qoida manbasining eng kichik mustaqil bo'lagi. Qator soni kitob
# PDF sidagi outline dan olingan, qo'lda emas: bob o'tkazib yuborilmaydi.
# kitob    - qisqa kalit, pastdagi jadvalda to'liq nomi
# bob      - kitobdagi bob yoki Item raqami, `A` appendix
# hujjat   - qoida tushadigan hujjat, `-` qamrovdan tashqari
#   qoshildi  - bobdagi qoida korpusga yozilgan, bo'lim izohda
#   bor        - qoida korpusda allaqachon to'liq bor, izohda bo'lim
#   tashqari  - korpus qamrovidan tashqari (GUI, desktop, imtihon mashqi)
#   clean-code-book  Robert C. Martin, Clean Code
#   clean-arch       Robert C. Martin, Clean Architecture
#   jcip             Brian Goetz, Java Concurrency in Practice
#   java-ref         Schildt, Java The Complete Reference 12-nashr (2022)
#   ocp-study        Boyarsky/Selikoff, OCP Java SE 17 Study Guide
#   ocp-practice     Boyarsky/Selikoff, OCP Java SE 17 Practice Tests
#   hfdp             Freeman/Robson, Head First Design Patterns 2nd
#   spring-micro     John Carnell, Spring Microservices in Action
#   spring-action    Craig Walls, Spring in Action 6th
#   spring-security  Laurentiu Spilca, Spring Security in Action
#   poeaa            Martin Fowler, Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
#   xunit            Gerard Meszaros, xUnit Test Patterns
#   dds              Brendan Burns, Designing Distributed Systems
#   refactoring2     Martin Fowler, Refactoring 2-nashr (2019), faqat preview
#   swe-google       Winters/Manshreck/Wright, Software Engineering at Google
#   arc              Boswell/Foucher, The Art of Readable Code
#   fundamentals     Richards/Ford, Fundamentals of Software Architecture
#   hard-parts       Ford va boshqalar, Software Architecture: The Hard Parts
#   just-enough      George Fairbanks, Just Enough Software Architecture
#   sa-for-devs      Simon Brown, Software Architecture for Developers
#   doc-sa           Clements va boshqalar, Documenting Software Architectures, qism
#   ddd-evans        Eric Evans, Domain-Driven Design (2003 manuskript nusxasi)
#   learning-ddd     Vlad Khononov, Learning Domain-Driven Design
#   legacy-code      Michael Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code
#   m2m              Sam Newman, Monolith to Microservices
#   sys-perf         Brendan Gregg, Systems Performance, faqat 6-bob
#   java-perf        Jack Shirazi, Java Performance Tuning 2-nashr (2003)
#   philosophy       John Ousterhout, A Philosophy of Software Design
#   jls              The Java Language Specification, Java SE 25
#   jvms             The Java Virtual Machine Specification, Java SE 25
#   wgjd             Evans/Verburg, The Well-Grounded Java Developer, 4-bob namunasi
#   clrs             Cormen va boshqalar, Introduction to Algorithms 3-nashr
#   deitel           Deitel, Java How to Program 9-nashr
#   deitel10         Deitel, Java How to Program 10-nashr, Early Objects
#   liang9           Y. Daniel Liang, Introduction to Java Programming 9-nashr
#   schildt11        Schildt, Java The Complete Reference 11-nashr (2019). 17-bobdan
#                    keyin raqam java-ref dan bittaga kam: schildt11 N = java-ref N+1
#   gof              Gamma, Helm, Johnson, Vlissides, Design Patterns
#   orosz            Gergely Orosz, The Software Engineer's Guidebook (2023)
#   evolutionary-keynote  Neal Ford, Building Evolutionary Architectures taqdimoti
#   learning-ddd-html     Khononov kitobining Google Books sahifasi
#   ddia             Martin Kleppmann, Designing Data-Intensive Applications
# Kitob matni repozitoriyga ko'chirilmaydi: mualliflik huquqi. Korpusga
# qoidaning o'zi o'zbekcha nasr bilan yoziladi va `## Manbalar` da kitob
# Tekshiruv darajasi: `qoshildi` qatorlar bob matni o'qilib yozilgan;
# `bor` qatorlar mavzu darajasida solishtirilgan (qoida nomi va kalit
# atamalari korpusda qidirilgan, mos bo'lim topilgan). Ya'ni `bor`
# qatorda qoida bor, lekin uning har bir jumlasi kitobga solishtirilgan
# emas: bu `docs/review.tsv` dagi bob tekshiruvining ishi.
# bobning har bir nomlangan qoidasi borligini bildirmaydi. Shuni
# tekshirish uchun olti kitob bo'lim darajasida audit qilindi:
# clean-arch, code-complete, legacy-code, philosophy, poeaa, xunit.
# 1218 nomlangan qoidadan 979 tasi korpusda bor edi, 155 tasi yo'q
# edi va shu sessiyada yozildi, 84 tasi `tashqari`. Eng past qamrov
# legacy-code da: 123 dan 44 tasi yo'q edi.
# Qolgan 34 kitob HAMON BOB DARAJASIDA. Ular uchun `bor` qatori
# "bobning mavzusi korpusda bor" degani, "bobning har bir nomlangan
# qoidasi bor" degani EMAS. Quyidagilarga audit kerak emas, chunki
# ularning qatori allaqachon eng mayda birlik: effective-java (Item),
# gof va doc-sa (bo'lim), sa-for-devs (uch betlik bob), jeps (bitta
# JEP), orosz, schildt11, sys-perf, wgjd, evolutionary-keynote,
# Qolgan besh `kirmagan` ning sababi bitta: bob tanasi nusxada yo'q
# Orosz kitobining katta qismi (karera, performance review, lavozim,
# jamoa dinamikasi) `tashqari`: korpus Java, Spring va PostgreSQL
# bo'yicha olti texnik hujjat, bu mavzularning uyi yo'q.
